err.default: That did not work. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the owner.
err.network: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is missing or not valid: {fields}.
err.NOT_FOUND: Not found — it may have been changed. Reload the page.
err.DUPLICATE: A courier account with this name exists already.
err.UNKNOWN_PROVIDER: The shop has no connection for this courier.
err.NO_ZONE_LIST: This courier publishes no area list: it reads the address itself.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
err.unauthorized: You are signed out. Sign in again.
err.NOT_PRINTABLE: Some stickers cannot be printed now: {fields}. Untick them, or re-book the parcel first.
err.popup: The PDF is ready but the browser blocked the new tab. It was downloaded instead.
err.REASON_REQUIRED: These stickers were printed before: say why they are printed again.
err.NOTHING_TO_HAND_OVER: Nothing is ready to hand over to this courier: {fields}. Print the stickers first, or re-book a parcel that changed.
err.ALREADY_HANDED_OVER: This batch was marked handed over already. Reload the page.
err.NOT_PACKING: This order is not being picked or packed now. Reload the page.
err.NOT_IN_ORDER: This code is not on this order: {fields}. Check the piece.
err.ALREADY_CHECKED: Every piece of this item is checked already: {fields}.
err.CHECK_MODE: The shop checks pieces another way now. Reload the page.
err.NOT_CHECKED: Some items are not checked yet.
err.PACKING_ISSUE_OPEN: A packing card is open: a person decides it first.
err.PHOTO_REQUIRED: Take the packing photo first (or the owner lets it go without one).
err.WEIGHT_GAP: The weight is far from the expected weight. Weigh again, or confirm it is right.
err.TOO_LARGE: The photo is too large. Take it again at a smaller size.
err.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: This order has moved on (or is on hold). Reload the page.
err.STALE: Someone changed this order just now. Reload the page.
err.CANCEL_PENDING: A cancel is waiting for this order: it is not packed.
err.CANCEL_REQUESTED: The customer asked to cancel: decide that first.
err.IN_REVIEW: This order waits for a review decision.
err.IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH: That press went twice with different values. Try again.
err.ISSUE_OPEN: This item has an open packing card already. Decide that card first.
err.ISSUE_DECIDED: This card was decided already. Reload the page.
err.PRICE_DIFFERS: That size or colour has another price: it cannot be swapped here.
err.OFFER_ON_ORDER: An offer on this order depends on this item: take it off on the order's page.
err.LAST_LINE: This is the only item of the order: cancel the order instead.
err.NOT_SAME_PIECE: That is not the same piece in another size or colour.
err.OUT_OF_STOCK: That size or colour is out of stock too.
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the permission for this.

couriers.title: Couriers
couriers.sub: Each courier account, its mode, and its own list of areas paired with the shop's.
couriers.empty: No courier account yet. Add one: it runs on its practice mode until the courier's keys are entered in Keys & connections.
couriers.noList: Reads the address itself — no area list to pair.
couriers.readQueued: Asked: the list is read in the background within the hour.
couriers.readDone: Done: the list is read and paired.
couriers.running: Being read: {calls} questions asked so far, {left} left.
couriers.practiceNote: Practice mode: nothing leaves the server; the practice list is a sample, not the courier's real one.

courier.stats: {city} cities · {zone} zones · {area} areas · {paired} paired by name · {unclear} unclear names
courier.statsDropped: {places} places and {pairs} pairs archived (the courier dropped them) · {restored} came back
courier.failed: The courier did not answer: {error}. Nothing was archived; read again later.
courier.candidates: Same name in the courier's list:
courier.noCandidate: No courier place with this name. Find one below.
courier.unpairAsk: Take this pair away? Parcels to this area then use the area above it, or wait for a new pair.
courier.droppedNote: The courier no longer lists {place}. The pair is kept for the record and comes back if the courier lists it again.
courier.emptyNeeded: No parcel is waiting for an area of this courier.
courier.emptyMapped: No area is paired yet. Press "Read the list now".
courier.emptyDropped: The courier has not dropped any paired place.
courier.noListLong: This courier publishes no area list: it reads the receiver's address itself, so nothing needs pairing.

packing.printSub: Courier stickers for every booked parcel still with us, in packing order: the category and style with the most pieces first. A sticker printed again is marked REPRINT.
packing.settingsNote: Change the size, printer and what one press prints in the cards below; the exact-amount line is in Delivery → More options.
packing.more: {n} more wait for the next print (up to {max} per print).
packing.emptySub: A parcel appears here once a courier is booked, and leaves when it is handed over or the courier picks it up.

problem.NOT_READY: order not ready (on hold or moved on)

words.setWhole: SET {name}: deliver whole — no single piece kept or returned

sample.name: Sample Receiver
sample.address: House, road, area, district (the address prints in full here)

reprint.label: Why print it again?
reprint.short: Write a short reason (at least 3 letters).
reprint.ask: Printed before: {orders}. Write why, then press Print again. It stays the same parcel.

handover.title: Handover
handover.sub: The parcels to give each courier's rider: booked, still with us, sticker printed. Print the sheet, let the rider tick and sign it, then mark it handed over.
handover.settingsNote: Paper, printer dots, language, names, signatures and "mark packed" are delivery settings (Delivery → More options).
handover.openBatch: Sheet printed ×{n} with {parcels} parcels, started {at}. Not handed over yet.
handover.emptySub: A parcel appears here once it is booked and its sticker printed, and leaves when it is handed over.

sheet.title: Handover sheet · {courier}
sheet.again: PRINTED AGAIN ({n}) — the same parcels, not new ones
sheet.copy: COPY — handed over to {rider} on {at}. Only the parcels that went.

sheet.d: How the rider's sheet prints: paper, printer dots, language, the receiver's name, the signature lines, and whether handing over also marks an order packed.
sheet.packOnHandover: Handing over also marks it packed
sheet.packOnHandoverHelp: Off: an order nobody packed is not ready and is left out. On: handing it over marks it packed too.

history.d: How far back the "Handed over" list above goes, and how many sheets it shows per courier.
history.perCourierHelp: 1 to 50. The totals still count every sheet in those days.

history.title: Handed over
history.sub: The sheets handed over in the last {days} days, per courier: who took them, who marked them, the parcels and the amount the courier collects.
history.more: Showing the latest {n}. Raise "Sheets per courier" to see more.
history.empty: Nothing handed over in the last {days} days.

picking.title: Picking list
picking.sub: Every piece to pull for the orders still with us — approved, or booked and not picked up — however many days they span. Category by category, the one with the most pieces first.
picking.rangeNote: Leave empty for every order still with us. Days only narrow the list: an order the courier has never enters it.
picking.badRange: The first day was after the last: showing all days.
picking.settingsNote: Paper, printer dots, language and "mark shortages" are delivery settings (Delivery → More options).
picking.emptySub: Orders appear here once they are confirmed, and leave when they are handed over to the courier.
picking.noHeld: None: every order still with us is counted above.

sheet.title: Picking list
sheet.held: Held and problem orders: {n}, listed at the end, not counted
sheet.allDays: Every order still with us, all days
sheet.heldTitle: Held and problem orders (not counted above):

tick.done: Pulled — tap to take the mark back

pack.title: Pack
pack.sub: Pick → Pack → Ready for courier → Handed over. A shortage always waits for a person — never cancelled by itself.
pack.startAllAsk: Start picking for all {n} orders on the Pick step? Orders on hold, in review or with a cancel asked are not on this list.
pack.startAllSome: {n} orders moved to Pack. Left out: {left}.
pack.weightPill: Weight check: more than {p}% and {g} g off
pack.settingsNote: The check, the photo and the weight check are delivery settings (Delivery → More options).

emptySub.pack: Orders arrive here when picking starts.
emptySub.ready: Packed orders wait here for the courier.
emptySub.done: Orders handed over today are listed here.

pack.more: {n} more at this step: finish these first.
pack.giftNote: Gift · prices hidden on the invoice · deliver on or after {day}
pack.giftNoteNoDay: Gift · prices hidden on the invoice
pack.issueTitle: Packing card open — packing and booking wait until a person decides
pack.issueOpen: A person decides each card. Nothing is cancelled by itself; a paid order's money back is only a request for the owner.
pack.heldNote: On hold — nothing moves until the hold is released.
pack.tickTitle: Tick each item as it goes into the parcel
pack.typePh: Scanner offline? Type the SKU here

photo.missing: Packing photo required before “Mark packed” and booking
photo.waived: No photo — the owner let it go: {reason}

weight.label: Weight (g)
weight.expectedNone: expected weight unknown (a piece has no weight)
weight.gap: {g} g ({p}%) off the expected weight. Weigh again, or:
weight.confirm: The weight is right — pack it

pack.noCourier: No courier account is switched on. Add one in Delivery → Couriers.

cost.title: Courier cost for this parcel
cost.none: No courier has a rate for this parcel yet: pick one yourself.

why.NO_BAND: the order has no delivery band
why.NO_RATE: no rate for this band and weight
why.NO_WEIGHT: a piece has no weight, and the rates go by weight

cost.note: What the shop pays the courier (Money → Costs & fees). The customer's delivery charge does not change.

block.NOT_CHECKED: “Mark packed” opens when every item is checked and matches.
block.PACKING_ISSUE_OPEN: A packing card is open: a person decides it first.
block.PHOTO_REQUIRED: Take the packing photo first (or the owner lets it go without one).
block.WEIGHT_REQUIRED: Type the parcel's weight, then “Mark packed”.

report.hint: The order gets a packing card and waits (on hold) until a person decides it.

card.booked: Booked with the courier: the parcel is the parcel. Another size or "send the rest" needs the booking cancelled first, on the order's page.
card.fine: The piece is fine after all
card.foundAsk: Close this card? The order goes on as it is.
card.restAsk: Take this item off the order and send the rest? A paid order gets a refund request for the owner; no money moves now.

whatNote.sticker: One press prints the new stickers.
whatNote.both: One press prints each new parcel's sticker, then its invoice, in packing order.
whatNote.invoice: One press prints the invoices of every parcel waiting, in packing order; no sticker is printed or counted.

printRun.needInvoice: Printing invoices here needs the "Print invoices" permission; ask the owner, or print stickers only.

set.readOnly: Only someone with "Change how the packing documents print" can change this.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this card a moment ago; it now shows theirs. Make your change again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: A value is not allowed; check the boxes.
err.forbidden: You may not change this card.

what.d: What the main print button prints. Always in packing order, as one PDF.
what.whatHelp: Stickers only (as before), each sticker followed by its customer invoice, or only the invoices.
what.layout: Invoices in the run print on

sticker.d: Set these to match your sticker printer. Print a sample sticker after a change.
sticker.sizeHelp: A label printer takes one sticker per label; A4 · 4 per sheet prints four stickers on one A4 page. "Own size" uses the millimetres shown in its name.
sticker.minScaleHelp: A parcel with many pieces gets smaller type down to this size before its pieces carry on onto a second sticker.
sticker.showShop: Shop's name and phone at the top

sample.heading: Invoice
sample.footer: A sample to check the printing — not a real invoice

check.d: Draws every document at every size in your settings from sample words, and checks the print rules: nothing cut, nothing overlapping, no ink in the edge the printer cannot reach, readable in black and white. Nothing is printed or counted.
check.allOk: Every document prints right at every size.

problem.EDGE_INK: ink too close to the edge
problem.FAINT: too light for black and white

check.err: The check could not run. Try again.

set.d: One letterhead on every document, and the edge the printer cannot reach.
set.logoOnLists: The shop's logo on the picking list and the handover sheet
set.logoOnListsHelp: The same logo as on the invoice (Brand settings). No logo set: the shop's name prints.
set.edgeMmHelp: 0 to 5. The print check wants no ink in this band.
